title: No backups on the critical path
detect_signals: Li owns five critical-path tasks with no one named to step in
sim_effect: A sick week or a clash for the busiest person stalls the critical path with no one ready to pick it up.
accepted_fixes: Name Perrick as backup for embedding and Li for distribution
Cross-train a backup on the critical-path tasks the busiest person owns
partial_fixes: Ask the supervisor to find cover if someone is out
List backups in the charter without telling the team
concept: Single point of failure: no critical-path task should depend on one person alone
sop_ref: PM SOP: roles and responsibilities; LD SOP: hand-off
explanation: When one person carries most of the critical path, any absence stops the project. A named backup who has seen the work can pick it up in days, not weeks.
note: Not planted on Rescue: after the re-baseline no one owns 4 critical-path tasks there, so clearing backups breaks nothing.
